is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F kdr) and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1R) (page 3, 'PCR detection of the L1014F kdr and ace-1 G119S mutations').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides the allelic frequencies for kdr and ace-1R, along with the number of mosquitoes genotyped (n=111 for kdr, n=44 for ace-1R) (page 4, Table 2).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from the field site Yaokoffikro in Côte d’Ivoire (page 2, 'Mosquito collection').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting new bioassays and molecular analysis on field-collected mosquitoes (page 1, Abstract).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the location as Yaokoffikro, a suburban village of Bouaké city (page 2, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study states that larvae were collected in June 2008 (page 2, 'Mosquito collection').

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes in 2008 to update resistance status after a political crisis.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype frequencies and sample sizes, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the insecticide resistance status of Anopheles gambiae s.s. from Yaokoffikro, Côte d’Ivoire, in 2008. It performed WHO bioassays and genotyped for L1014F kdr and ace-1 G119S mutations, finding high resistance and high allelic frequencies for both markers.
